nodes.label: Customer
nodes.description: Places orders from the web or mobile app.

nodes.label: API Gateway
nodes.description: Terminates TLS, authenticates the caller and routes requests.

nodes.label: Order Service
nodes.description: Validates the order and stores it. Publishes an OrderCreated event.

nodes.label: order-events topic
nodes.description: Kafka topic carrying OrderCreated events to downstream consumers.

nodes.label: Fulfilment Service
nodes.description: Consumes OrderCreated events and reserves stock.

nodes.label: Event Archive
nodes.description: Long-term archive of every event for audit and replay.

edges.label: Archive every event to long-term storage for audit and replay

scenes.title: Customer places an order
scenes.text: The request enters through the gateway and reaches the Order Service.

steps.caption: The customer submits an order over HTTPS.
The gateway authenticates the caller and forwards the request.

scenes.title: Order is saved and paid
scenes.text: The Order Service writes the order and charges the card.

steps.caption: The order is written to the database, which grows by one row.
In parallel, the service asks the payment provider to charge the card.

scenes.title: Event goes onto the topic
scenes.text: OrderCreated events are queued so consumers can work at their own pace.

steps.caption: The service publishes OrderCreated; it waits in the topic until a consumer is ready.
A second order arrives and queues behind the first.

scenes.title: Consumers drain the topic
scenes.text: Fulfilment reads the oldest message first; the archive copies events for audit.

steps.caption: Fulfilment takes the oldest event off the topic and reserves stock.
The archive copies the next event, so the archive store fills up over time.
